This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md file contains local setup instructions for running with MinIO, but omits mentioning S3_ENDPOINT or bucket creation. We should update the instructions under 'Running locally' to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket when using MinIO.
